highlights: 附件清理限定在聊天输入区，避免触发侧栏或页面其他区域的删除操作。
切换会话后确认聊天输入框与网关就绪，页面准备失败时停止发送，不再忽略错误。
包含扩展 1.0.2，按当前普通/无痕窗口及会话 URL 读取 Cookie。
highlights_en: Scope attachment cleanup to the composer, avoiding delete actions in sidebars and other page areas.
Confirm composer and gateway readiness after resetting a thread; stop sending when page preparation fails.
Include extension 1.0.2 with cookie selection scoped to the current regular/incognito window and session URL.
